newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's Telstra sees moderate profit rise.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's Telstra sees moderate profit rise.

text.p: Australia's Telstra Corp said on Friday that it expected moderate profit growth in 1996/97, after the removal of A$1.1 billion in redundancy provisions.
"I can confirm that if you take redundancy provisions out of the equation we do expect some moderate growth in the profit result," Paul Rizzo, group managing director, told reporters.

The company, which is owned by the Australian government and earmarked for a one-third A$8 billion privatisation in the current life of Parliament subject to upper house approval, earlier said 1995/96 net profit soared by 31.5 percent to A$2.30 billion.
Telstra chief executive Frank Blount, speaking at the same news conference, said he expected annual capital expenditure to be steady at about A$4.0 billion over the next three years.
After that, capital expenditure would "drop off", Blount said.
